title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Case Western Reserve University, from the historic wood-block streets of Hessler to the vibrant Italian eateries of Little Italy.

cards.title: The Uptown District
cards.subtitle: Euclid Avenue at East 115th Street
cards.notes: Walk this modern corridor to find the university bookstore, local eateries, and the Museum of Contemporary Art Cleveland.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant residential and retail corridor serving as the university's modern 'main street.'
cards.evidence_claim: Uptown is a vibrant residential, shopping, dining, and entertainment district located on Euclid Avenue in the University Circle neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Explore the Uptown District - Cleveland - University Circle
cards.access_notes: Public street with 24/7 sidewalk access; business hours vary.

cards.title: Hessler Road Historic District
cards.subtitle: Hessler Road and Hessler Court
cards.notes: Visit Cleveland's only remaining wood-block paved street, a historic site of student activism and community preservation.
cards.short_summary: A historic residential street known for its unique wood-block paving and counterculture legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Hessler Court is the only remaining Cleveland street to have wood block paving and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
cards.source_title: HESSLER RD. AND HESSLER COURT HISTORIC DISTRICT | Encyclopedia of Cleveland History

cards.title: Little Italy Main Street
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road Corridor
cards.notes: Stroll past historic bakeries and galleries in this century-old neighborhood adjacent to the south campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary thoroughfare of Cleveland's historic Little Italy, famous for its cultural heritage and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy was established by Italian immigrants who settled in the area that is now Mayfield and Murray Hill Roads.
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; best explored on foot during daylight or evening dining hours.

cards.title: The Base of the Hill
cards.subtitle: Murray Hill Road
cards.notes: Find student-friendly pizza shops and the historic Holy Rosary Church at this intersection of campus and community.
cards.short_summary: A key residential and commercial street connecting the university's south campus to Little Italy.
cards.evidence_claim: Murray Hill Road is one of the two primary streets defining the historic Little Italy neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Little Italy Cleveland – A Historic Neighborhood
cards.access_notes: Public street; connects directly to the South Residential Village.

cards.title: The Museum Gateway
cards.subtitle: Ford Drive
cards.notes: Walk this block to reach the Glidden House and the entrance to the university's North Residential Village.
cards.short_summary: A scenic street bordering the campus that houses historic architecture and provides access to Wade Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Glidden House is located at 1901 Ford Drive, placing visitors in the midst of University Circle attractions.
cards.source_title: Attractions & Things To Do In University Circle - Glidden House
cards.access_notes: Public street; primary route for North Campus move-in.

cards.title: The Humanities Walk
cards.subtitle: Bellflower Road
cards.notes: Visit the Undergraduate Admission Welcome Center or explore the future site of the university's Humanities Building.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, tree-lined street on the northern edge of campus home to several university administrative and academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Undergraduate Admission Welcome Center is located at 11402 Bellflower Road.
cards.access_notes: Public street; central to the North Residential Village.

cards.title: North Village Corridor
cards.subtitle: Juniper Road
cards.notes: Navigate this street to find first-year residence halls like Cutter and Smith in the Juniper Residential Community.
cards.short_summary: A primary residential street for first-year students living in the North Residential Village.
cards.evidence_claim: Cutter House is a traditional-style residence hall in the first-year Juniper residential community on Juniper Road.
cards.source_title: Cutter House - Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Public street; often restricted to one-way traffic during move-in periods.

cards.title: The Uptown Shortcut
cards.subtitle: East 115th Street
cards.notes: Use this street as a pedestrian shortcut between the South Campus and the shops at Uptown.
cards.short_summary: A residential street that serves as a key pedestrian link between different sections of the University Circle area.
cards.evidence_claim: This section of E. 115th is often used today by students as a quick shortcut to Uptown.
cards.source_title: East 115th Street - A series on abandoned buildings in University Circle
cards.access_notes: Public street; includes the university's Sustainability House at the corner of Wade Park Ave.

cards.title: The Medical Link
cards.subtitle: Cornell Road
cards.notes: Access the university's health and counseling services or the dental research building along this busy corridor.
cards.short_summary: A critical street for the university's medical and dental programs, connecting campus to University Hospitals.
cards.evidence_claim: University Health and Counseling Services is located at 2124 Cornell Rd.
cards.source_title: University Circle and Cleveland | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Public street; high traffic area near hospital facilities.

cards.title: The Arts & Antiques District
cards.subtitle: Larchmere Boulevard
cards.notes: Explore ten blocks of independent shops, vintage stores, and bookstores just a short distance from the campus orbit.
cards.short_summary: A quirky, independent shopping district known for its 'upbeat vitality and offbeat charm.'
cards.evidence_claim: Larchmere Boulevard is ten blocks of unique shops, art and vintage stores, and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial district; best visited during weekend business hours.
